correctness.rationale: On two-sided independent innovation sequences the stationary affine series converges in L2 because E[(1-F)^2]=1-d<1. The expectation and second moment recurrences give E[X]=a/mu, E[X^2]=a^2(2-mu+mu*c)/(mu*d). Conditioning on the independent next removal gives covariance one step ahead; iteration of the conditional affine expectation multiplies it by (1-mu)^(k-1) at every k>=1. Direct factorizations prove the two Pearson-correlation envelopes and equality conditions. The exact rational checker from the submitted package passes 31,192 counted exact-rational checks; seeded finite simulations support three Beta examples but are not universal proofs.

value.rationale: Observed pollutant export and stored contaminant mass are observables of different risk relevance; a physically natural stationary system can have positively persistent stock and negatively dependent event exports. The formula gives the exact boundary in removal variance versus buildup variability for all positive lags and determines distribution-free extremal autocorrelations; at deterministic accumulation the negative extremum is independent of the distribution of removal fractions. This supplies a motivated structural diagnostic for interpreting temporally sampled pollutant-load series. It does not claim site validation or practical optimization without calibrated dependent rainfall/removal processes.
